notes: Prototype variants were added in phases while the first-pass suite ran; existing successful variants retained their arithmetic. Input guards, reporting fields, resource cleanup and new inactive branches were added later.

Early workflow runs omit the hook hash. Before hook_hash_time=module_start was added, that field hashes the file at report time rather than at module import. Treat those hashes as file-state evidence, not an exact imported-code attestation.

The follow-up runs use the final numerical implementations and record hook hashes at module start, except the first few repeats predating that instrumentation. Production source is independently hashed on every workflow run.
Initial baseline runs marked capture_matrix include writing a reference matrix and are excluded from repeated timing summaries.
RUN_NOTES.json identifies the sample spanning an environment reconnect; its numerical evidence is retained and its timing sample is replaced.

After the reconnect, the original controller exited between the completed workflow phase and the factor-benchmark phase. No numerical job was active at that boundary. Remaining phases were resumed under a fresh controller; completed evidence was preserved.

Final monitor cleanup removed only its unused historical catalog; the run function was unchanged. Final analysis reports unavailable factor-work time as null, not zero. Multi-block spool and both singular disk-factor controls were added before final control execution.

An additional dense_refined factor control was added after raw double LU missed the 1e-12 backward-error gate on the PEC8k random RHS. The failed raw result is preserved; successful PEC8k factors are compared against the refined control when available. Existing benchmark variants were not numerically changed.

The final aggregate comparison flagged two equal-electrical-size 15 GHz compressed cases above the study-only 1e-8 cross-backend field flag. Existing production gates were unchanged and passed. The 1e-8 comparison remains an explicit reported flag rather than silently discarding cases or changing a release gate. A final operator14 diagnostic tightens only operator compression tolerance; its inactive hook does not change earlier variants.
Final operator14 was an accuracy diagnostic and overlapped aggregate analysis; RUN_NOTES.json excludes its timing/RSS from performance conclusions. Aggregates were regenerated after it finished.
